resources.string: SaveVault finds your emulator and game save locations and backs up each game into recoverable versions. When connected to a SaveVault cloud server, versions sync automatically across your other devices (such as PC and Steam Deck).
• Each backup creates a version and skips unchanged saves; restoring creates a safety snapshot first so you can undo.
• Sources are emulators, launchers, or folders you authorize; only confirmed save locations are backed up by default.
• When two devices modify the same game, neither is silently overwritten — you choose how to resolve it in Sync & Tasks.
• Full gamepad control: A confirm, B back, L1/R1 switch tabs, Y open command palette.

Without Root, SaveVault can only read folders you authorize through the system picker. Recommended folders list detected emulators for one-tap authorization; use Add Authorized Folder for anything else.

• Public folders (such as PSP, RetroArch, eden) open directly to their save directory\n• App data for emulators like Eden or DroidDeck can be chosen from the picker sidebar\n• For emulators not listed, tap Add Authorized Folder to pick their save folder manually
With Root, SaveVault can also access protected directories such as Android/data (for example Switch emulator saves). Choose Grant Forever in Magisk so background auto-backup runs unattended.

SaveVault Cloud is your self-hosted save sync server. Once connected, new backups upload automatically and updates from other devices appear in Sync & Tasks. You can skip this now and configure it later in Settings → Cloud.
